papers.title: Surface Finishing of Additive Manufactured Titanium Alloy by Plasma Electrolytic Polishing Without Pretreatments
papers.abstract: The advent of the additive manufacturing of Ti-6Al-4V (Ti64) alloys has facilitated the production of complex geometries for various industrial applications. Nevertheless, the inherent surface roughness of selective laser melting (SLM)-produced parts remains a critical limitation, adversely affecting fatigue life, wear, corrosion, and compliance with stringent surface quality standards, for example those required in hygienic applications. Conventional post-processing methodologies, encompassing grinding and electropolishing, are frequently multi-stage, labor-intensive, and reliant on hazardous electrolytes, which thus limits their use for certain applications. In this study, plasma electrolytic polishing (PEP) was evaluated as a single-step finishing process for 3D-printed Ti64 components. The findings indicate that PEP efficiently diminished surface roughness from initial values of approximately 9-10 µm to as low as 0.38-0.5 µm within a time frame of 15-20 min, depending on the initial surface condition. These outcomes meet hygienic surface requirements while ensuring the use of environmentally compatible electrolytes. The findings establish PEP as a non-mechanical, efficient, and scalable additive-manufacturing post-processing strategy. It has the capacity to supersede conventional multi-stage workflows and offer substantial reductions in cost, time, and environmental impact.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti-6Al-4V的等离子电解抛光后处理工艺，但未提供力学性能数据，仅关注表面粗糙度。
llm.why_not_core: No fatigue or tensile testing results; only surface roughness measurements without mechanical performance evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: SLM Ti-6Al-4V的高表面粗糙度限制了其疲劳寿命和卫生应用。
summary_zh.method: 对SLM Ti-6Al-4V施加等离子电解抛光（PEP）处理。
summary_zh.result: PEP在15-20分钟内将粗糙度从9-10μm降至0.38-0.5μm。
summary_zh.validation: 表面轮廓仪测量粗糙度。

summary_en.motivation: The high surface roughness of SLM Ti-6Al-4V parts adversely affects fatigue life and hygienic compliance.
summary_en.method: Plasma electrolytic polishing (PEP) was applied as a single-step finishing process to as-built Ti-6Al-4V coupons.
summary_en.result: PEP reduced surface roughness from initial ~9-10 µm to 0.38-0.5 µm within 15-20 minutes.
summary_en.validation: Surface roughness was characterized by contact profilometry.

llm.relevance_to_user: 论文直接涉及Ti-6Al-4V增材制造件的后处理（等离子电解抛光），但未提供疲劳或力学性能数据，因此对用户关注的后处理对力学性能影响的研究仅有参考价值。
llm.why_not_core: This paper reports only surface roughness reduction and does not provide any mechanical testing (fatigue, tensile) or microstructural characterization of the post-processed material.

summary_en.motivation: The inherent surface roughness of SLM-fabricated Ti-6Al-4V limits fatigue life and compliance with hygienic standards.

summary_en.result: PEP reduces surface roughness from approximately 9–10 μm to as low as 0.38–0.5 μm within 15–20 minutes.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via surface profilometry measurements only.

papers.title: In situ synthesized 3D network structure TC4 metal matrix composites reinforced by the graphene via using laser additive manufacturing
papers.abstract: Due to high flexibility, non-mold short working cycle, free-from parts structure, and material constraints, laser additive manufacturing (LAM) has been applied to compose nanoparticle-reinforced metal matrix composites. In this work, cost-effective combined with high-performance 3D network graphene nanosheet (GNS) with TiC particles-reinforced Ti–6Al–4V (TC4) composites were conveniently prepared via the LAM process, leveraging the in situ Ti + C → TiC chemical reaction. This preparation method facilitated the formation of a highly uniform reinforcement phase network (GNS-TiC/Ti) distributed within the Ti–6Al–4V α/β matrix. The size of the GNS-TC4 grain decreased synchronously as the addition of GNS increased, primarily caused by the in situ TiC nanoparticles pinning effect along grain boundaries, which plays a limiting role in the process of grain growth. Mechanical result indicated that the incorporation of 1 wt% GNS resulted in 1.56 % increase in microhardness and 29.7 % increase in yield strength compared to the direct addition of TiC-reinforced TC4. The analysis of the alloy structure at the subsurface of the fracture revealed the uniform distribution of the situ-generated TiC particles in the alloy matrix, and no defects of the pores were observed around the particle. The reinforced strength of the GNS-TC4 is attributable primarily to shear-lag strengthening and thermal mismatch strengthening mechanism. This work furnishes new thoughts into the preparation of balanced-performance titanium matrix composites when combined with laser additive manufacturing technology.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了激光增材制造的石墨烯增强TC4复合材料的力学性能，对理解Ti-6Al-4V基复合材料的强化机制有参考价值，但非纯Ti-6Al-4V的力学与疲劳特性。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on a graphene-reinforced Ti-6Al-4V composite, not on the mechanical or fatigue characterization of pure additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V, and provides no fatigue data.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用激光增材制造原位合成石墨烯增强TC4复合材料，提升力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过激光增材制造原位反应（Ti+C→TiC）制备3D网络结构GNS-TiC/TC4复合材料，并表征其微观结构与力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 添加1wt%GNS使显微硬度提高1.56%，屈服强度提高29.7%，强化机制为剪切滞后和热错配。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微硬度测试、拉伸测试和断口微观分析验证力学性能与组织结构。

summary_en.motivation: To develop cost-effective high-performance titanium matrix composites by in situ synthesizing graphene nanosheet and TiC particle reinforcements within Ti-6Al-4V using laser additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: Laser additive manufacturing was employed to fabricate a 3D network GNS-TiC/Ti composite via the in situ reaction Ti + C → TiC, with graphene nanosheets and TiC nanoparticles uniformly distributed in the α/β matrix.
summary_en.result: Incorporation of 1 wt% GNS increased microhardness by 1.56% and yield strength by 29.7% compared to directly added TiC-reinforced TC4, attributed to shear-lag and thermal mismatch strengthening mechanisms.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through microhardness and tensile tests, and the fracture subsurface analysis confirmed uniform TiC distribution with no pore defects.
